title: Eventual Monotonicity of the Willmore Energy under Mean Curvature Flow
summary: We establish the eventual monotonicity of the Willmore deficit \( \int_ΣH^2\,dμ-16π\) along the mean curvature flow of smooth closed embedded strictly convex surfaces in \( \mathbb R^3 \), thereby complementing Huisken's exponential convergence with an eventual monotonicity property. As a consequence, the Hawking mass is eventually nondecreasing along the contracting mean curvature flow, in contrast with the usual inclusion monotonicity expected of the Hawking mass.
